g.text: CAD development — deterministic evaluator, part trials, then Docker
Proposed progression:
1. Cylinders, sleeves, caps: basic dimensions and volume.
2. Bolt / nut bodies: named features, bores, mating references.
3. External / internal thread pairs: profile, pitch, handedness,
engagement and clearance at recorded assembly poses.
4. Custom threaded nuts and matching profiles.
5. More complex booleans, fillets, intersecting bores, lofts.
Each family includes expected-good and intentionally-bad cases.
Select the next fixture family and its outcome
Define independent expected measurements, tolerances,
required views, failure cases, and execution budget
Implement or change file-based evaluator, checks, result contract
Run local Makefile verification suites through uv
contracts / geometry / views / exports / reuse / failures
Inspect Rich progress and summaries + JSON reports / HTML gallery
including JSON/inline annotations, errors, and timeouts
Verify one build -> many queries with stable geometry
and native-snapshot restore without source execution
no
Service contract or known-result regression fails?
yes
Run CAD-agent task trial against the fixed fixture criteria
Agent submits code -> inspects images / checks -> revises
Record success / failure, final evidence,
iterations, runtime, and questions requiring user input
Trial exposes a service defect?
yes
no
Fix service; rerun affected deterministic regressions
Refine task context / agent instructions if needed
no
Trial needs revision and budget remains?
yes
Retain trial evidence and report the unmet outcome;
resolve the service defect or missing task information
no
Assigned part outcome demonstrated?
yes
Start delegation with cylinders / cap geometry.
Review reports and artifacts before expanding the fixture family.
Failure is a retained result; do not relax criteria to obtain a pass.
An image review and a numeric assertion are different evidence types.
Review fixture-family evidence and readiness for the next family
Package the working service in isolated Docker
Run the same fixtures and agent trial contract
with mounted inputs / outputs and execution limits
Fix packaging / runtime configuration
Repeat the affected acceptance checks
yes
Container behavior or isolation checks fail?
no
Delegation outcome package
source + repeatable commands + fixture corpus
reports / images / optional exports + known limitations
Review draft: M-CAD-21-29 and M-CAD-37-42. Local Makefile targets are planned, not implemented.
Deterministic service regressions and CAD-agent task trials are separate development loops.
Local CLI works before MCP. The same requests and result files survive packaging and adapter work.
Thread profile and clearance criteria need selection before the thread stage (M-CAD-26).
Geometric checks are the software gate; physical printed fit is separate evidence.
